summary: This directory is dedicated to the testing infrastructure for generating merge plans, serving as a specialized verification area for validating the logic that determines how updates are structured and merged within the system.
responsibilities: Verify the generation logic of merge plans
Ensure accuracy of update integration sequences
Test boundary conditions for merge plan construction
relationships: The merge plan serves as the structural output generated by the update processing logic.
The verification suite evaluates the correctness of the merge plan under various update scenarios.
designDecisions: Collocation of test logic with build routines
Isolation of integration verification from core build execution
